mission: To ensure every local business has the visibility, technology and personal support they need to thrive in the age of AI search.
aboutText: We rebuild your website to better reflect your business. We run our audit so local searches can lead customers straight to you.

services.name: Custom Web Design & Development
services.description: Clean custom code and modern website redesigns engineered for fast page loads, AI search recommendations and customer conversion.

services.name: AEO & SEO Website Audit
services.description: Our comprehensive audit identifies why your business is not recommended to local customers. Allowing us to fix these issues so local searches can lead more customers to you.

services.name: Consulting & Site Migration
services.description: Strategic guidance on website redesign. Once built, we transfer your existing site smoothly without losing your domain, emails, or active leads.

services.name: Web Hosting & Administration
services.description: We manage your website hosting, security and updates so you can focus on what matters, running your business.

services.name: Search Engine Readiness
services.description: We organize your prices, hours and services in a clean format that AI bots can easily read, verify and quote to local callers.

services.name: Copywriting & Content Adjustments
services.description: Clear website text that communicates your value instantly. Encouraging local clients to call or book online and AI bots to recommend your business.

services.name: Performance & Visibility Audit
services.description: Deep analysis of your current website to uncover hidden speed issues, broken mobile layouts and reasons AI tools are recommending your competitors instead of your business.

services.name: Accessibility Compliance
services.description: WCAG 2.2 compliant web standards and clean site layouts, making it easy for every customer to navigate your website smoothly on any device while keeping you legally compliant.

services.name: Security & Privacy Compliance
services.description: Robust security measures, privacy compliance and site protection standards to safeguard your business and customer data.
